annotations.text: THE TERMINAL LAYOUT — taken from the Interblock G4 photo: centred plaque on a hairline rule, ONE row of portrait tiles with the name in a footer band, a tap prompt with carousel dots, and a persistent status strip along the bottom. The strip is where the wallet balance sat on the terminal; here it holds the live session, so resuming is always one tap away. Tile art is drawn in CSS and SVG - there are no photographs available.
1 · JACKPOT TERMINAL — yellow chrome, black hexagon plaque, hard offset shadows. The saved bright theme on the terminal skeleton.
2 · TERMINAL CLASSIC — the faithful translation: charcoal chrome, trapezoid plaque, thin coloured tile frames, condensed caps. Closest to your photo, and the darkest of the six.
3 · FELT TERMINAL — bright table green with brass trim and an arched plaque. Reads as a card room rather than a slot floor.
4 · RETRO TERMINAL — motel marquee plaque with chasing bulbs, arched tile tops, cream and turquoise. Most characterful.
5 · CANDY TERMINAL — cream chrome, pill plaque, glossy chips, fully rounded strip. Softest and friendliest.
6 · NEON TERMINAL — indigo chrome, neon-tube plaque and tile frames. The trending online-casino read.
